title: #2894 part 2 A, rebuilt on #2907 — 3-D: heavy figures settle sooner, and a value the givens fix is shown (PR, port 5204)

cases.title: 3-D: a point slid along a side to a stated length draws much sooner
cases.lookFor: Start from «נקה הכל». After «AD = 3» the figure is drawn, D on AB with AD = 3, noticeably sooner than on prod (timed in the PR). Nothing is refused; three rows.
cases.before: prod draws the same figure, but «AD = 3» takes about three times as long (timed in the PR).

cases.title: 3-D: a vector from a known point gives its head's coordinates
cases.before: prod lists no row for B: its coordinates are withheld although A and AB fix them.

cases.title: 3-D: asking for that head answers it
cases.before: prod answers that B is not determined.

cases.title: 3-D: a cube that may stand on either side of its base plane does not claim a side
cases.lookFor: The data panel lists «A'(0, 0, ?)»: the cube may stand above or below z = 0.

cases.title: 3-D: the exam cube's answer is still accepted (a double root the speed-up must leave alone)
lines: נסמן: AB = u, AD = v, AA' = w
cases.lookFor: Every line builds; «A = (3, -4, 0)» is accepted as its own row.
